stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: Where did my second line go?

stations.title: Tab records
stations.text: A line break in a value ends the record.
stations.note: A cut record reads as whole.

stations.title: Your records
stations.gap: No sure end to a record

captions: Sefton asks where the second line of his note on the card stock went.
Tab records end at any line break, and a record a stop cut short reads as whole.
You write records that hold any text, and leave out and cut off a broken end.
The note comes back with both lines, and a cut record changes nothing.
The log now holds any text and survives a stop in the middle of a write.
